items: Elevators can serve more than two stops and have an adjustable travel speed. Two-stop cars still select the other floor automatically. In larger elevators, choose your floor after boarding. If a stop opens over empty space, stepping out lands you on the highest platform below.

World Builder can create, resize, and name flat platforms. Connected platforms can form bridges and walkways, and each platform can have its own footstep sounds. Widgets can now occupy more than one square.
To mute one person’s voice just for yourself, select them in the user list and press the Applications key or Shift+F10. On touch, use Actions.
World Builder can save named checkpoints. Preview what a restore will change before applying it. Restoring also saves a checkpoint of the world you’re leaving.
Clocks gained 11 time-zone choices, including Phoenix, Adelaide, and Easter Island.
Add doors to walls in World Builder. A wall can have several doors, and a four-digit PIN can protect one or both sides. Unlocking a door leaves it closed until someone presses Enter to open it.
Use Duplicate here in the Z item menu to make an independent copy of an item. You own the copy and can edit it separately.
Give areas names with Regions in World Builder. Press C to hear your coordinates and any regions you’re in, smallest first. A closet inside a studio reads “Closet, Studio.”
@akj improved automatic reconnection after server restarts and made world saves more resilient to interruptions.
Non-radio items now share controls for emitted sounds, including range, volume, direction, and effects.
Added teleporters. Set a destination in x, y, z coordinates to travel between floors with your held items. Audio fades out at departure and back in at arrival.
Added ambiances to World Builder. Place a looping sound over a rectangular area and choose how far it fades beyond the edges.
Added optional HRTF spatial audio. Press Shift+4 to toggle it, Q or E to turn 45 degrees, and F to hear which way you’re facing. In HRTF mode, the arrow keys move relative to your facing direction.
Voice chat now recovers more reliably after network interruptions, microphone loss, and audio-device changes.
You can now hold up to 2 items at once. Press H to hear what you are holding. You will also hear what others are holding if you list users, and can hand held items to others near you.
Added walls. Press W for the World Editor. Walls can optionally block sound or movement.
Added last seen time to users.
Expanded clock object with many more time zones.

Added a second floor. To make this work, added an Elevator object. The Elevator appears on both floors. Press Enter to use it and Shift+Enter to hear its status. You can only teleport to users or items on your floor, and you can only see items from your floor. More to come in this area.
First pass at touchscreen controls.
Switched voice chat support to use LiveKit.
First public release, v0.1.0.
Added a command palette with Shift+K, Shift+F10, or the Applications key to show all available commands.
Added Item Management menu with z, to transfer items or delete them. Shift+D is gone now.
Added initial delay and loop delay for widgets, letting you do looped audio that has pauses.
Added chat actions with /me.
Added /version and /up commands for server status.
Added user roles/permissions system.
Added an admin menu and management commands
Clock item type now is an actual talking clock with optional alarm and top of hour announcement.
Added secondary actions with Shift+Enter. Currently, it works on the radio for now playing.
Added now playing for media streams.
Added user accounts. Username cannot be changed but nicknames can.
Did a lot of behind-the-scenes work, including rewriting the item system and moving a lot of things away from the client. If things break, please let me know.
Added a Piano item type.
Teleporting now takes a bit of time.
You can now use left and right arrows on item properties to quickly adjust them.
Added volume adjustment for other users. Press left or right arrow from the user list.
Improved handling of audio streams so only nearby ones will be loaded, saves a ton of bandwidth.
Moved Use item to Enter Key instead of u, moved speak users to U from Shift U.
Added up/down arrows and page up/page down for numeric field adjustment.
Added user volume control and calibration.
Added support for Dropbox links and HTTP streams for item sounds and radio stations.
You will no longer repeatedly hit walls.
Added a generic Widget item type. This type lets you edit a variety of global item properties, and you can use remote URL's for sounds.
Added tooltips for items and item properties. Press space from the Add Item or properties menus.
Added directional audio support, used now for the Radio item type.
Added audio layers to toggle voice, item sounds, media, and world (other users).
Added new item type clock.
Changed the E effect key to open a menu list for choosing effects.
Moved chat key from apostrophe to slash.
Added simple first-letter navigation for menus and lists.
Added Channel property for radio items (stereo, mono, left, right).
Added new wheel item type with configurable spaces and spin results.
Added movement/teleport sounds.
Added Shift+O inspector mode to read all item properties.
Added paste support for chat and text-entry fields.
Persisted player position across refresh/reconnect.
Added loopback monitoring toggle for hearing your own effect.
